# Cases of jq_diff's .test files where qj on Windows doesn't match jq 1.8.1's
# jq-windows-amd64.exe, and why (.github/jq_diff_windows.py --known). Anything
# else that mismatches fails the windows job.

# lgamma: jq.exe, built with MinGW, has MinGW's own lgamma; qj calls UCRT's,
# which differs in the last digit for these inputs.
